images.alt: Program-as-Weights compiles a natural-language function specification in the cloud into discrete text and a continuous LoRA, then executes inputs on a local neural interpreter
LoRA compiler hidden states are mean-pooled and mapped to coefficients over shared LoRA A and B bases before the generated adapter is attached to a frozen interpreter

FuzzyBench task-family distribution: core text processing 30 percent, search and web intelligence 18 percent, classification 15 percent, code and commands 12 percent, safety and domain knowledge 12 percent, agentic tool use 8 percent, and format repair 5 percent

Three function specifications compile into separate pseudo-program and LoRA pairs that are hot-attached to one device-resident interpreter for email triage, JSON repair, and personal-information redaction
